hook: Follow a newspaper debate on working from home and spot exactly where the argument turns and where the author speaks.
intro: A pro-and-contra text on working from home, about 320 words, written the way opinion pieces in German newspapers and magazines are written: Befürworter betonen … Kritiker weisen jedoch darauf hin, dass … Beide Seiten haben gute Argumente … Entscheidend ist … The structure is the Stellungnahme in full — the common view, the supporters’ argument with survey evidence, the critics’ argument with the same survey read the other way, the compromise most companies have chosen, and the author’s conclusion. The language is typical of the genre: Konjunktiv I for the reported positions (Termine könnten besser vereinbart werden; die Grenze verschwimme; wer ständig erreichbar sei, arbeite mehr), verbs with prepositions (hinweisen auf, aufgeben), and the connectors jedoch, hinzu kommt, daher marking the turns. Read once for the shape, once for the answers; then look at how the text does what you will do yourself when you write a forum post or a comment.
tips[0].title: The Stellungnahme shape
tips[0].text: Introduction (the topic as often presented) → pro (Befürworter betonen …, with the survey) → contra (Kritiker weisen jedoch darauf hin, dass …, with the same survey and a second problem) → the compromise (eine Mischung) → conclusion (Entscheidend ist …; weder Fluch noch Segen). Five moves, seven question targets.
tips[0].check.why: Befürworter are the supporters; their view forms the pro section, before the turn to the critics.
tips[0].visual.moves[0].label: Topic
tips[0].visual.moves[1].label: Pro
tips[0].visual.moves[2].label: Turn
tips[0].visual.moves[3].label: The author's view
tips[1].title: jedoch / allerdings = the turn
tips[1].text: The word that flips the argument. Everything before is pro, everything after is contra. In your own writing, use it once, at the hinge.
tips[1].check.why: allerdings, like jedoch, marks the turn: what follows argues against what came before.
tips[2].title: Entscheidend ist … = the author's view
tips[2].text: The author steps in only at the end — Entscheidend ist, dass … / Letztlich kommt es darauf an, … That sentence answers 'Was ist laut Text entscheidend?'.
tips[2].check.why: The author steps in at the end with Entscheidend ist …, in the indicative; the others report other people's positions.
remember[0]: Pro – jedoch – contra – Mischung – entscheidend: the five-beat text.
remember[1]: Reported positions in the Konjunktiv (verschwimme, sei, arbeite); the author’s own claims in the indicative.
exam: Pro-and-contra opinion articles are a typical reading text in the B2 exam — and in any German newspaper’s weekend edition.
tips[0].check.q: 'Befürworter betonen, dass man zu Hause konzentrierter arbeite.' Which part of a pro-and-contra text is this?
tips[1].check.q: 'Der Weg zur Arbeit entfällt. Allerdings fehlt vielen der Kontakt zu den Kollegen.' What comes after allerdings?
